ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies slipped on the morning, with Bitcoin falling below $83,000 and ETH down nearly 2%, while BNB managed a modest gain. The decline is driven by geopolitical tension affecting oil prices and heightened uncertainty around regulatory clarity and AI‑related risks. New token listings on Delta India add potential upside but remain secondary to the broader downside pressure.
